name: Trang An
blurb: Trang An features a UNESCO World Heritage-listed landscape of limestone karst peaks, rivers, and caves explored via boat tours. Visitors can choose from multiple boat routes, including Route 3 which passes through a 1,000-meter dark cave and the Kong: Skull Island film set.

positive: Enjoyable and relaxing boat tours through caves and past temples
Scenic limestone mountain and river scenery
Affordable travel destination with good local food options
negative: Some boat routes can be crowded
Caves can cause anxiety for visitors uncomfortable with enclosed spaces
Weather can occasionally involve rain or high heat

quotes.text: Trang An's best boat route is the one they won't offer you: Route 3, the King Kong route. 3.5 hours, 1,000m of dark cave, and the valley from Kong: Skull Island. Same 250,000 VND ticket as the crowded routes — just ask for Route 3 by name at the counter. https://vietadvisor.travel/ninh-binh/trang-an
📢 The UNESCO World Heritage-listed Trang An landscape is a relatively new tourist attraction and has learnt from the mistakes of other regions.
Floating down a river in Trang An, Vietnam is a solid 10/10 experience 🇻🇳
